description: This file defines the ConfigHelper class, which provides methods to get, set, and delete configuration values in the 'hs_hr_config' database table within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the database schema and connection to manage configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing configuration settings stored in the 'hs_hr_config' database table, including retrieving, updating, and deleting configuration values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection, either from the stored connection or via the static method.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for inspecting database schema details.

methods.name: getConfigValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a configuration setting by name, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets or updates the value of a configuration setting in the database.

methods.name: deleteConfigValue
methods.description: Deletes a configuration setting from the database and logs the deletion.
